Hi Neha / Marissa,

Thanks again for the overview last week. Our engineering team at BrightClinic is ready to move from POC to a production integration, but before we commit we need a focused technical deep-dive covering:

- SDK best-practices for streaming responses and reconnect semantics
- Tool / function-calling patterns and recommended safety checks
- Authentication and token rotation recommendations for long-running sessions
- Expected latency profiles and how batching/kv-cache will affect our design

Can we schedule a 60-90 minute architecture review next week with your architects and an SDK engineer? We’d like to include our lead backend engineer (cc’d below) and our SRE.

Proposed agenda (we're flexible):
1) 15m - integration overview and goals
2) 30-45m - runtime/SDK deep-dive (streaming, reconnects, backpressure)
3) 15-20m - tool/function calling patterns + security considerations
4) 10-15m - Q&A and next steps / action items

Our internal attendees:
- Sophia Wilson, Platform Lead (sophia.wilson@brightclinic.com)
- Miguel Ortega, Backend Lead (miguel.ortega@brightclinic.com)
- Priya Shah, SRE (priya.shah@brightclinic.com)

Thanks — availability windows are Tue/Wed 10am-2pm ET or Thu 1pm-4pm ET.

Best,
Sophia
